message: リ・クリエの武器とならん
After school that day, the topic of Azel came up again.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wonder... if Azel-san is starving.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so too, Lolotte?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't tell me you do too, President! For a Demon Lord, you certainly know a lot about angels! I'm amazed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Angels barely eat any food. Rather, it's because they have no need to.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it, Azel was always drinking nothing but Vandine Jelly. The kind that doesn't even feel like you're eating anything.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nutrition isn't necessary to sustain an angel's body. However, that only holds true while they are in Heaven...」

name: Misa
message: 「And that's due to the difference between physical matter and spiritual essence...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You humans get hungry, right? And if you don't eat food, you die, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The exact same thing happens when an angel becomes closer to a human.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Or so Amyrina told me. Ahem.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though you're always starving hungry, Lolo-chan.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. After all, the very first reason I took an interest in the Human World was because I wanted to eat delicious food.」

name: Misa
message: 「That makes it easy to see why you get along so well with Sally-san...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To think you already understood the circumstances of angels. Impressive as expected, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No... it's not really like that...」

name: Ria
message: 「Wait, if that's the case and Azel-san hasn't eaten anything this whole time--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It means she will starve, just like a human would.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's bad!\s01 Once today's special training is over, let's all go talk to Melilot-san.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good work today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... excuse me, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Can we really not... please let us help with the search too?」

name: Melilot
message: 「For Azel...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes」
I relay the story I heard from Lolotte just as it was told.

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, the adverse phenomenon that occurs during an angel's material transition」

name: Synn
message: 「Every second counts!! That's why--」

name: Melilot
message: 「*Sigh*... How many times must I tell you before you understand? You should just focus on doing what you're supposed to do」

name: Synn
message: 「But Azel is...!」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot... You're stubborn, sure, but these kids are just as stubborn as you are, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena, please don't butt in either. If we do anything more to encourage the Crusaders--」

name: Helena
message: 「Calm down, Melilot. That's not like you. What are you hiding?」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be something about Azel...」

name: Melilot
message: 「N-No, it's not!」

name: Synn
message: 「We've believed in you this whole time, Melilot! And yet...」

name: Helena
message: 「If you won't trust them, there's no way you can work together」

name: Helena
message: 「It's precisely because they trust you that they've endured such harsh trials all this time. Do you intend to betray those feelings?」

name: Helena
message: 「Have the courage to trust them, Melilot. Neither you nor they are as weak as you think」

name: Melilot
message: 「...That's not it. It's not like that...」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot...」

name: Helena
message: 「Everyone, I'm sorry. Could you call it a day and head back for now?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Understood. We'll leave the rest to you」

name: Helena
message: 「Yeah, thank you」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey, what's wrong, Melilot... Normally you would always come to me for advice」

name: Melilot
message: 「I didn't want... to drag you into this, Helena...」

name: Helena
message: 「What do you mean? Does this have something to do with Azel-chan?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena... what would you do? If you were forced to fight a friend」

name: Melilot
message: 「I cannot... force those children to do something like that...」

name: Helena
message: 「It's not decided for sure that Azel-chan is an enemy, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「At the very least, our goals do not align. Just like the Demons, she also intends to take advantage of this chaos to do something」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even now while in hiding, she has put up a powerful barrier and refuses to let anyone near her」

name: Melilot
message: 「Part of it is because we had overlooked Azel-san until now, but she shows no sign of listening to persuasion at this late stage」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if that persuasion comes from Sakura-kun...」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is why, before she clashes with the Crusaders, I will with my own hands--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, shut-in. Don't go underestimating the Demon Lord, ya hear?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Great Sage Paqy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen up. I've served Demon Lords for a long time. Even among 'em, that bastard Synn Sakura feels like the second coming of the First Demon Lord」

name: Melilot
message: 「How can you say such a thing!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The First Demon Lord... well, the folks like me, only joined hands and tried to help each other once we were staring the worst-case scenario right in the face」

name: Paqy
message: 「It wasn't like we planned it from the start. We just didn't have any other choice left」

name: Helena
message: 「But Synn-chan is different. Just by being who he is, he's joined hands with others and helped them out. Long before things ever got this bad」

name: Melilot
message: 「At this point, he has already surpassed our imaginations. That is what you are saying, isn't it」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's what Helena meant by the courage to believe」

name: Helena
message: 「It's the courage to believe that Synn-chan will pull off something crazy, that he'll come through for us. Because that boy--」

name: Everyone
message: 「Is a total airhead」

name: Melilot
message: 「Pfft... heehee, because he's an airhead... there is no telling what he might pull off, I suppose」

name: Helena
message: 「The probabilities you're talking about can't be relied on at all in front of the Demon Lord」

name: Paqy
message: 「Saying you'll take on the dirty work yourself is the kind of line a brat spouts. There's no need for you to end up like yours truly or Lumiel and the others」

name: Paqy
message: 「Melilot. You live your life to the fullest in the present era. That's the role of those who have life」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Understood. I will tell you everything I was trying to do」

name: Melilot
message: 「In exchange, let us make sure we never push the responsibility onto them alone. No matter what happens」

name: Helena
message: 「Of course」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's what our job as guardians is all about」
Melilot seemed as though she were being cornered by something.
For Melilot, who always puts on such a brave front, to get that worked up.
Beyond that point, there was nothing to do but leave it to Helena, who's known her for a long time.
That said, it didn't feel right to leave everything entirely to her, so--

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy. About Azel... what do you think we should do?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Paqy?」
I wonder if he went out somewhere. It's cold, so maybe I should've made him a scarf or something so he wouldn't catch a cold.
Well, I'll just make it for a Christmas present.

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for calling. This is Grand Palace Sakura」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn? Sorry for calling so late at night! You see--」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn, over here, over here」

name: Synn
message: 「What's going on?」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, well. Melilot said she'll tell us where Azel is」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Paqy
message: 「Given the hour, y'know. She probably doesn't wanna make too big a fuss out of it」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, true. Wait, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You be the one to tell the others, Demon Lord」

name: Helena
message: 「I've been waiting, Synn. Let's get right to it--follow me」
When we arrived and headed over, I saw Melilot standing still with a book in one hand.

name: Melilot
message: 「...Phew」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「You've arrived」

name: Synn
message: 「What were you doing?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I was setting up a magic circle」

name: Melilot
message: 「This magic circle is meant to seal Spirit Power. It's similar to the one Soltia used to seal our magic power before」

name: Synn
message: 「Spirit Power, so that means it's for Azel......」

name: Melilot
message: 「For the past few days, I've sensed a strong barrier here. She's most likely hiding inside Finis Tower」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, there hasn't been any sign of her making a move since then」

name: Helena
message: 「Or rather, she couldn't move」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me...... because she's hungry?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee...... really, what am I going to do with you」

name: Melilot
message: 「Perhaps so. Whatever the reason, if she isn't moving, that works in our favor as well」

name: Helena
message: 「For setting a trap...... right」

name: Ria
message: 「So you really do think Azel-san is an enemy」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's unfortunate, but the likelihood is high enough that it's difficult to overturn」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, with this, even if Azel-san turns her blade on us, we should be able to neutralize her」

name: Synn
message: 「And that gives us a chance to talk with her, right」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Though whether she'll actually listen to persuasion remains to be seen」

name: Helena
message: 「What are you going to do, Melilot?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Words like "likelihood." I'm no longer relying on them anyway」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let's believe in Sakura-kun's words. I'm activating the magic circle」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, Azel......」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just one last thing. If you sense any danger to yourself, don't push it--just run」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please make sure you at least keep that promise. Do you understand?」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's do our best, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't forget. Because I'm always with you, Synn-kun」

name: Helena
message: 「Whew, I'm getting jealous~~」

name: Helena
message: 「However, Ria. It's unfortunate, but you're going to wait here with me」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehh, no way, I don't want to」

name: Helena
message: 「We're going to seal away Spirit Power. You're only borrowing a guardian angel's power, so what could you possibly do when push comes to shove?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, that's true, but......」

name: Helena
message: 「Waiting for a man is also a woman's job, you know」

name: Ria
message: 「Look who's talking, when you've never even dated a guy before」

name: Helena
message: 「Because the guys who confess to me all lack mature charm~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai. If we're always together, then we're together even when we're apart」

name: Helena
message: 「Lo-vey-do-vey\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, Sis!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun. Let's go」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes! Well then, I'm off!!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Take ca~~re」

name: Synn
message: 「It's too quiet......」

name: Melilot
message: 「This barrier blocks out almost everything perceived by the five senses. It's just like a simplified version of Heaven, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「When it's completely silent, my ears start ringing. I can't really bring myself to like this feeling......」

name: Melilot
message: 「This might simply be normal for angels」

name: Melilot
message: 「Rumor has it that not just hearing, but touch, taste--all of his senses have been lost.」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like I can understand why Lolotte came to the Human World.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, to be able to construct a barrier of this magnitude, Azel must be quite powerful even among the angels.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think you're plenty impressive yourself for being able to infiltrate it, Melilot.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... uuugh...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Shh, be quiet...」

name: Azel
message: 「W-Who's there...」
From beyond the pitch-black darkness, an unsteady shadow sways.

name: Azel
message: 「Why... why do you interfere... I will... make the world... anew...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The world...!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I get it, so this guy's a fanatic.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Melilot
message: 「To think there was actually an angel who took such absurd theories seriously... How deplorable.」

name: Paqy
message: 「To put it simply, there are folks out there who think this Re-Crea is a force meant to regenerate the world.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh...? If that happens, what becomes of us?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Naturally, every single person living there goes kaput.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Such a thing. As if I would ever allow it...」

name: Synn
message: 「So Azel actually believes in a pipe dream like that?」
What is he planning to do right in the middle of the Holy Night Festival?

name: Melilot
message: 「World regeneration... I won't let you do it!」
Looking at each other and nodding--

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!!」
They leaped out in front of Azel.

name: Azel
message: 「...So it is you... Demon Lord... and Nibe.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Taking advantage of Re-Crea to regenerate the world by merging the three realms... There is no way you could ever pull that off.」

name: Azel
message: 「...The Lord chose me...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Come to your senses already. Even if you are an angel, there's no way you have that kind of power--」

name: Azel
message: 「I erased the Bylous」

name: Melilot
message: 「What did you say...」

name: Azel
message: 「I will tolerate... no further... interference...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What the--!?」
The sky, where the curtain of night should have fallen.
Amidst the usual downpour of shooting stars, stars fall as if painting right over them.
The trails of the stars fill the sky.
The number of falling stars is, quite literally, as countless as the stars themselves.
An amount impossible to even count blankets the entire sky.
The stars grow brighter and brighter, filling the air with a brilliance unimaginable for night.
Following their trails with our eyes, there is a commonality that defies all logic.
Every single meteor was heading straight toward this very Finis Tower!

name: Melilot
message: 「N-No way... Are the shooting stars heading toward Azel-san...」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That means...」
Does this mean Azel is the one causing this meteor shower phenomenon?

name: Melilot
message: 「A case like this... I've never seen anything like it before...」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, it's useless, Azel-san!! Your Spirit Power is sealed and unusable!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「The magic circle!?」
It collapses all too easily.

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san! Azel is...!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Guh!!」
Melilot-san opens her book and launches an attack on Azel.

name: Melilot
message: 「Get down!!」
Chanting swiftly, she hurls the magic-infused book toward Azel.

name: Melilot
message: 「Come forth!!」
From within the opened book, warriors summoned from the Demon World appear and charge at Azel.
However, the light surrounding Azel envelops those fierce warriors, swallowing them whole.

name: Melilot
message: 「N-No way... It didn't work at all...」
In the blink of an eye, every single page is used up, and the book vanishes into the light.
The sheer shockwave from that moment sends Melilot's body flying violently into the air.

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot!!」
Though she was launched high into the air, it seems she somehow managed to stick the landing.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you doing this...」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... uuugh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop it, Azel! Doing something like this--」

name: Azel
message: 「C-Can you people... stop...」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying you can bend your own beliefs that easily!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Urgh... uwaaaah!!」
Along with an agonizing scream, Spirit Power began overflowing from Azel's body.

name: Melilot
message: 「T-This is the power of Re-Crea... The power of world rebirth dwelling within an angel...」

name: Azel
message: 「T-The time is... ugh, guh... not yet, ripe...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel is in pain! I have to help him!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun!? Stop! If you get caught in that maelstrom, you won't stand a chance!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now is our only chance!! Let's run!! Hurry!!」

name: Synn
message: 「But Azel is--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you want to die!?」
Seeing Melilot's ghastly, desperate expression, I remember what she warned me about at the start.
I can't betray her trust over a momentary surge of emotion.

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot, can you walk?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I can manage...!」

name: Synn
message: 「*Huff*, *huff*, *huff*」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn!!」

name: Helena
message: 「That shooting star just now... what on earth happened...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll explain the details later, right now we need to get away from here as fast as possible!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I-It's alright... Azel isn't chasing us...」

name: Synn
message: 「I... I see... *sigh*...」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot. What about persuading Azel--」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Yes. I'm sorry, an unforeseen situation occurred...」

name: Synn
message: 「In response to Azel, shooting stars came gathering together」

name: Ria
message: 「T-To Azel...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The power of Re-Crea was dwelling within her」

name: Ria
message: 「H-How could that be...!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Not even Melilot's magic circle could hold it back」

name: Helena
message: 「That massive amount of energy--if you call it Re-Crea, it makes total sense. Though I really don't want to believe it」

name: Melilot
message: 「A power far surpassing even Bylous. He had already outlived his usefulness, and by Azel's own hand...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why would Azel want to do something like that...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If, as hypothesized, Re-Crea desires the rebirth of the world, then Azel might be controlled by that power」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, she did ask whether one could ever bend their own convictions」

name: Helena
message: 「I wonder if Azel truly believes she's carrying out a sacred mission...」

name: Helena
message: 「That she was chosen. That sense of duty telling her she must see it through is what's driving her forward」

name: Synn
message: 「She's suffering so much... and yet, does Azel seriously intend to remake the world?」

name: Melilot
message: 「She likely has no thought for what will happen by doing so. Nor even what will become of herself as a result」

name: Helena
message: 「You could almost call him a martyr, couldn't you? Poor thing...」

name: Synn
message: 「He finally made it to this academy, you know? Even an angel, if he spent time with us like Lolotte does...」

name: Synn
message: 「If he had just... spent time with us... things wouldn't have ended up... like this. Damn it...!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not your fault, Synn. You mustn't blame yourself like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Azel simply had circumstances he couldn't compromise on. That's all there is to it.」

name: Synn
message: 「But... Azel was all alone the whole time... suffering so much... and I didn't even know...」

name: Ria
message: 「You're very kind, Synn. But with that kindness alone... do you really think you can overcome Azel's conviction?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't know when he came to harbor the power of Re-Crea. However, ever since then... Azel has lived his life staying true to his conviction.」

name: Ria
message: 「There's no way mere sympathy could ever persuade someone like Azel.」

name: Ria
message: 「You have no choice but to confront conviction with conviction!」

name: Synn
message: 「My... conviction...」
My conviction... What kind of conviction could possibly allow me to stand on equal footing against Azel?
Is it my conviction as the Demon Lord? Or else--.

name: Helena
message: 「At any rate, it seems we'll need to devise new countermeasures immediately.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel will surely make his move when the energy of Re-Crea reaches its critical point--」

name: Melilot
message: 「According to projections, that will be December 24th. On that day, the fate of the world may be decided.」
